svg.title: Saarthi end-to-end POC architecture
svg.desc: Camera and optional CAN inputs feed perception, a causal buffer, a temporal model, independent present-state and forecast lanes, an SGCA support contract, decision policy, and audit log.

svg.text: From pixels to a decision contract
Two decision lanes share perception, but only the forecast lane is allowed to abstain.
Green = present safety lane · Blue = predictive advisory · Amber = evidence/support gate
